verdict.rationale: Convex documents real-time sync and reactive queries that rerun and push updates to subscribed clients when the underlying data changes. A developer could plausibly build presence and shared state by writing to tables and subscribing to them. However, nothing in the pack documents a presence feature, a presence component, or non-persisted ephemeral broadcast, so this rests on inference from general reactivity. Missing for 10: any documented presence-tracking capability or component, ephemeral (non-persisted) broadcast or pub/sub between clients, connection/disconnect detection, and hands-on corroboration.
